[Signora Villari](/person/1444)’s graceful story has been safely received, and shall be commenced in January 1880[^2]

C M Yonge


[^2]: Villari\'s \'The Angel of Viareggio: A Tale of Child-Life in Italy\' began in MP ns 31 (January 1880) and ran until July.
